name: search_addresses
description: Find homes in England and Wales by street, postcode, town or address.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Street, postcode, outcode, town or full address, as a person would type it: 'Merton Road, SW19', 'BS7 8', 'Ash Street, Salford M6', '41 Denning Road NW3'.

arguments.name: sale_pairs
arguments.desc: Filter to homes whose sale history contains these sales, each as 'price:year', e.g. ['450000:2019'].

arguments.name: response_likelihood
arguments.desc: Only homes with this response likelihood.

arguments.name: sort
arguments.desc: 'recent' newest sale first (default); 'likelihood' High first, then Medium, then the rest; 'price_desc' / 'price_asc' by last sale price; 'addr' by address.

arguments.name: page
arguments.desc: Page number; `limit` addresses per page.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Addresses per page: 20 by default, up to 60.

name: get_address
description: One home's card, the quick answer to "is this house for sale" and "does the owner live there": full address, last sale, freehold or leasehold, whether it is owner-occupied (from its Energy Performance Certificate), whether it is listed for sale (with the portal, the agent and the link to the advert), its response likelihood (High = listed for sale and owner-occupied), and the link that opens a letter to its owner on GetMovely.

arguments.name: akey
arguments.desc: Address key from search_addresses (hex string).

name: address_report
description: Everything GetMovely knows about one home in one call.

arguments.name: akey
arguments.desc: Address key from search_addresses (hex string).

name: street_price_per_m2
description: Recent Land Registry sales near one home with their EPC floor area, as pounds per square metre and per square foot by year.

arguments.name: akey
arguments.desc: Address key from search_addresses (hex string).

name: price_trends
description: What freehold or leasehold, new build or resale, energy rating and floor area are worth per square metre in one postcode district, for one property type (D detached, S semi-detached, T terraced, F flat), by whole calendar year, against the national picture.

arguments.name: outcode
arguments.desc: Postcode district (outcode) such as 'SW19', 'BS7', 'M6'.

arguments.name: property_type
arguments.desc: Property Type

arguments.name: factor
arguments.desc: Factor

name: whats_nearby
description: Train, tram and ferry stops, bus stops, primary and secondary schools, cafes and restaurants, pubs, takeaways, supermarkets, parks and play areas around one home, from official open data, within 100 m to 2 km: for each kind the count, the nearest one and its distance.

arguments.name: akey
arguments.desc: Address key from search_addresses (hex string).

arguments.name: radius_m
arguments.desc: Radius in metres, 100 to 2000.

arguments.name: closest
arguments.desc: Instead of counts within the radius, list the N closest places of this one kind (expanding rings up to 16 km).

arguments.name: n
arguments.desc: N

name: tenure_check
description: Whether homes matching an address are freehold or leasehold, from the tenure recorded on the latest Land Registry sale of each exact address, with that sale's date.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Address or street with postcode, e.g. '12 Church Lane, BS7 8AB'.

name: house_age
description: The construction age band of homes matching an address, from the Energy Performance Certificate, with what that era means for the construction, plus the first recorded sale year as corroboration and the property type.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Address or street with postcode.

name: sale_history
description: Every recorded sale of one home since 1995, from HM Land Registry price paid data: price, month and year, the price per square metre each sale works out at on the home's current EPC floor area, and the change from the first sale to the last.

arguments.name: akey
arguments.desc: Address key from search_addresses (hex string).

name: energy_performance
description: A home's Energy Performance Certificate in plain terms: rating and score now and the rating it could reach, modelled running costs a year for heating, hot water and lighting, carbon dioxide, which parts of the building are weak (walls, roof, windows), and the assessor's own list of improvements with their indicative costs.

arguments.name: akey
arguments.desc: Address key from search_addresses (hex string).

name: price_check
description: Is a price in line? Works out the price per square metre from the home's EPC floor area and sets it against three things: what homes of the same type sold for per square metre in the same postcode district in the latest whole year, with the quartiles; recent sales on the home's own street or postcode; and the home's own last sale moved by the district's change since.

arguments.name: akey
arguments.desc: Address key from search_addresses (hex string).

arguments.name: price_gbp
arguments.desc: The price to check, in pounds: an asking price, an offer, a valuation.

name: compare_homes
description: Two to four homes side by side, one row each: type and floor area, tenure, last sale and its price per square metre, energy rating and modelled running cost, what the street has sold for recently, the district trend, whether it is owner-occupied, whether it is listed for sale and its response likelihood (High = both), the nearest supermarket, primary school, station and park, recorded crime and air quality.

arguments.name: akeys
arguments.desc: Two to four address keys from search_addresses.

name: find_address_from_sale_history
description: Property portals often hide the house number but show the home's past sale prices.

arguments.name: area
arguments.desc: Where the listing says the home is: a street with its district ('Merton Road, SW19'), a postcode or its first half ('SW19 1'), or a town.

arguments.name: sales
arguments.desc: Past sales shown on the listing, each as 'price:year' in pounds, for example ['450000:2019', '310000:2012'].

arguments.name: match
arguments.desc: 'any' (default): the home has these sales, possibly among others.

name: area_overview
description: What homes sell for in one postcode district, for every property type sold there (detached, semi-detached, terraced, flats): the latest whole year's median price per square metre with its quartiles and number of sales, the change since the series began in 2015, and the year in progress against the same months a year earlier.

arguments.name: outcode
arguments.desc: Postcode district such as 'SW19', 'BS7', 'M6'.

name: compare_areas
description: Two to six postcode districts side by side for one property type: latest whole year's median price per square metre with quartiles and sales, change since 2015, the year in progress against the same months a year earlier and, when a floor area is given, what that many square metres cost at each district's median.

arguments.name: outcodes
arguments.desc: Two to six postcode districts, for example ['SW19', 'BS7', 'M20'].

arguments.name: property_type
arguments.desc: One type, held constant across the districts: D detached, S semi-detached, T terraced, F flat.

arguments.name: floor_area_m2
arguments.desc: Optional floor area to price at each district's median, for example 100.

name: district_statistics
description: GetMovely's published research for one local authority district, with England and Wales alongside: the share of homes that are leasehold (houses and flats separately), how many years pass between sales of the same home and the share not sold for 20 years or more, the share of purchases resold within two years, and how big homes are (median floor area, by property type and built form).

arguments.name: district
arguments.desc: A local authority district in England or Wales by name: 'Bristol', 'Camden', 'Merton', 'Leeds', 'Cardiff'.

name: search_homes_for_sale
description: Homes currently advertised for sale in an area of England or Wales, by criteria: "find me a 3-bed under £400k in BS7", "flats over 60 m2 in Wimbledon".

arguments.name: area
arguments.desc: Where to look: a postcode district ('BS7'), a full postcode ('SW19 1AB'), a town ('Wimbledon'), or a street with its district or town ('Elm Road, BS7').

arguments.name: max_price_gbp
arguments.desc: Highest asking price in pounds.

arguments.name: min_price_gbp
arguments.desc: Lowest asking price in pounds.

arguments.name: min_bedrooms
arguments.desc: Min Bedrooms

arguments.name: max_bedrooms
arguments.desc: Max Bedrooms

arguments.name: property_type
arguments.desc: From the advert's own words.

arguments.name: min_floor_area_m2
arguments.desc: Smallest floor area in square metres.

arguments.name: tenure
arguments.desc: As recorded at the home's last sale.

arguments.name: epc_ratings
arguments.desc: Energy ratings to keep, for example ['A','B','C'].

arguments.name: owner_occupied
arguments.desc: True: only homes whose Energy Performance Certificate records them as owner-occupied (response likelihood High).

arguments.name: sort
arguments.desc: 'newest' advert first (default), by asking price, by asking price per square metre (lowest first), or largest first.

arguments.name: page
arguments.desc: Page number, 20 homes a page.

name: find_homes_not_for_sale
description: Homes that are NOT advertised for sale, by criteria: the homes a buyer could write to.

arguments.name: area
arguments.desc: Where to look: a postcode district ('BS7'), a full postcode ('SW19 1AB'), a town ('Wimbledon'), or a street with its district or town ('Elm Road, BS7').

arguments.name: property_type
arguments.desc: From the home's Energy Performance Certificate, which does not say detached, semi-detached or terraced.

arguments.name: min_floor_area_m2
arguments.desc: Min Floor Area M2

arguments.name: max_floor_area_m2
arguments.desc: Max Floor Area M2

arguments.name: tenure
arguments.desc: As recorded at the home's last sale, so homes with no recorded sale are left out.

arguments.name: epc_ratings
arguments.desc: Energy ratings to keep, for example ['E','F','G'] for homes that need work.

arguments.name: last_sold_before_year
arguments.desc: Last sold before this year: long-held homes.

arguments.name: last_sold_after_year
arguments.desc: Last sold in or after this year.

arguments.name: no_recorded_sale
arguments.desc: Homes with no sale on record since 1995 (held longest of all): 'only' those, or 'exclude' them.

arguments.name: min_last_sale_price_gbp
arguments.desc: Min Last Sale Price Gbp

arguments.name: max_last_sale_price_gbp
arguments.desc: Max Last Sale Price Gbp

arguments.name: owner_occupied
arguments.desc: True: only homes whose Energy Performance Certificate records them as owner-occupied (response likelihood Medium), where a letter reaches the owner.

arguments.name: sort
arguments.desc: 'owner_occupied_first' (default, the website's order), 'longest_held' oldest last sale first, 'recent' newest sale first, by last sale price, or largest floor area first.

arguments.name: page
arguments.desc: Page number, 20 homes a page.

name: recent_sales
description: What sold in an area, newest first: "what sold near here this year", "flats sold in SW19 since January for under £500k".

arguments.name: area
arguments.desc: Where to look: a postcode district ('BS7'), a full postcode ('SW19 1AB'), a town ('Wimbledon'), or a street with its district or town ('Elm Road, BS7').

arguments.name: property_type
arguments.desc: D detached, S semi-detached, T terraced, F flat (the Land Registry's own classes).

arguments.name: sold_from
arguments.desc: Earliest sale date, 'YYYY-MM-DD', or a year ('2026' means from 1 January 2026).

arguments.name: sold_to
arguments.desc: Latest sale date, 'YYYY-MM-DD', or a year ('2025' means to 31 December 2025).

arguments.name: min_price_gbp
arguments.desc: Min Price Gbp

arguments.name: max_price_gbp
arguments.desc: Max Price Gbp

arguments.name: min_floor_area_m2
arguments.desc: Only sales of homes at least this big.

arguments.name: tenure
arguments.desc: As recorded on the sale.

arguments.name: new_build
arguments.desc: New-build sales only, or leave them out.

arguments.name: page
arguments.desc: Page number, 20 sales a page.

name: stamp_duty
description: How much stamp duty: Stamp Duty Land Tax for a home in England, Land Transaction Tax for one in Wales, for a home mover, a first-time buyer or an additional property, with the tax in each band and the other two buyer cases beside it.

arguments.name: price_gbp
arguments.desc: Purchase price in pounds.

arguments.name: country
arguments.desc: Where the home is.

arguments.name: buyer
arguments.desc: 'home_mover': replacing a main home, the standard rates.

arguments.name: non_uk_resident
arguments.desc: Buyer is not a UK resident (adds 2% in England).

name: draft_letter
description: Hand a letter the person has agreed with you to GetMovely.

arguments.name: akey
arguments.desc: Address key from search_addresses (hex string).

arguments.name: letter_text
arguments.desc: The message the person has agreed, as plain text: what goes in the body of the letter.

name: search_guides
description: GetMovely's plain-English guides to buying and selling homes in England and Wales: contacting an owner directly and the law on it, buying or selling without an estate agent, finding who owns a property or the address behind a listing, how often sales fall through, speeding a sale up, best and final offers, stopping unwanted letters.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: What the person wants to know, in plain words: 'is it legal to write to a homeowner', 'who owns the freehold', 'how many house sales fall through'.

name: read_guide
description: The full text of one GetMovely guide as Markdown, with the questions it answers, the primary sources it cites (GOV.UK, HM Land Registry, the ICO, The Property Ombudsman and others) and the date it was last updated.

arguments.name: slug
arguments.desc: Guide slug from search_guides, for example 'is-it-legal-to-write-to-a-homeowner'.
